thread:
oncall-bot: Paging: high error rate + latency spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — 500s and token retries. alert_id=ALRT-237345
Ella SRE: seeing a big uptick in KV cache evictions and continuous-batching queue length. 95th latency jumped to ~1.2s. Rolling error % ~6%.
Marc Eng: I can repro locally with load generator; batch windows keep growing and prefix hash misses explode. seems correlated with a recent tokenizer rollout yesterday.
Irene Eng-ML: confirmed — tokenizer v2 mapping changed some byte offsets. prefix->promptkey hashing uses tokenized length in the key. mismatch means different keys for same logical prompt.
Jordan Ops: any quick mitigation we can do at infra level to stop the blowup? we need to reduce memory pressure and stop paging.
Ella SRE: immediate mitigation: reduce continuous-batching.max_window_ms to 25ms and set batch.size_cap to 16 for affected pools. That should throttle batching growth.
Marc Eng: pushing a hotfix to the runtime config now. patch:
```
# runtime config
continuous_batching:
  max_window_ms: 25
  size_cap: 16
kv_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 900
```
deploy-bot: roll-out started: runtime-config/2026-03-15T21:20Z -> canary 3 pods
Raj CS: heads-up: two customers reported increased latency in their SLAs. I flagged accounts: AcmeHealth and Shoply. they're seeing timeouts in user flows.
Mia Product: label customer impact P1? Product needs an incident summary for postmortem.
Irene Eng-ML: longer-term fix: decouple promptkey hashing from tokenizer-dependent offsets. need to rederive stable normalization that uses canonical token IDs or original text canonicalization.
Marc Eng: agreed. for now, I'll add a compatibility layer that accepts both v1/v2 tokenization keys and backfills requests to the correct cache key when we detect mismatch.
Ella SRE: update: canary rollout looks good on 3/3 pods, latency dropping. but KV eviction still high because of key churn — setting kv_cache.ttl to 300s temporarily to let cache settle.
Jordan Ops: running scrub on hot shards to reclaim memory: `shardctl evict --age>1200 --grace=10s` on pool=redwood-usw2-a
oncall-bot: Incident annotated: INC-237345 - kv/prefix-cache amplification during tokenizer rollout. paging status -> acknowledged. responders: Ella SRE, Marc Eng, Irene Eng-ML, Jordan Ops
Marc Eng: pushing a small runtime patch to accept legacy key form. diff:
```
if compute_key(prompt) not in cache:
  alt = legacy_compute_key(prompt)
  if alt in cache:
    use alt
```
Ella SRE: hotfix deployed to canary, then staged to 50% traffic. Observed error % drop from 6% -> 0.8% and 95p latency to 320ms.
Raj CS: messaging customers with status update now. ETA for full mitigation?
Marc Eng: estimate 45-60m to roll the compatibility patch and KV TTL ramp. will monitor for regression.
Mia Product: coordinator note: prepare incident-redwood-dashboard link and add customer impact blurb.
Irene Eng-ML: follow-up actions: (1) revert tokenizer mapping change, (2) design stable promptkey spec independent of token offsets, (3) add unit tests for tokenizer-key compatibility.
Jordan Ops: handoff to night oncall in 1hr. leaving runbook snippet in incident doc and posting commands to #eng-oncall.
Ella SRE: thanks team. I'll craft the postmortem skeleton and assign action items. tagging @Mia Product and @Raj CS for customer comms.
deploy-bot: rollout complete: runtime-config/2026-03-15T21:30Z -> global
Marc Eng: monitoring shows steady metrics now. I'll leave tracing capture on for 24h to ensure no silent regressions.
Ella SRE: closing pager in 30m if stable. moving to incident-handoff and postmortem workstreams.
